iso_cloud_controls._comment: Source table of scripts/gen_iso_cloud_index.py: the additional controls of ISO/IEC 27017 and ISO/IEC 27018 (identifiers and this library's own short labels only, no ISO text). Everything sits under one top-level key because `opa test .` loads the JSON files of scripts/ as data.scripts.<top-level key>.

iso_27017.replaces: ISO/IEC 27017:2015 | ITU-T X.1631:2015 (first edition; its seven CLD.x.y.z controls do not appear in this edition's numbering)
iso_27017.base: ISO/IEC 27002:2022 (93 controls); this edition adds 4 cloud-specific controls, marked CLD in its contents

sources.what: Publisher's public preview PDF (VDE Verlag): cover (Second edition, 2026-07), contents (clauses 5.38, 5.39, 8.35 and 8.36 marked CLD; Annex A correspondence with the 2015 edition; Annex B monitoring of cloud services), foreword (cancels and replaces the first edition; controls merged, removed and introduced), scope (guidance for cloud service customers and providers)
IEC webstore catalogue page: Edition 2.0, publication date 2026-07-27
Estonian Centre for Standardisation catalogue page: ISO/IEC 27017:2026, valid from 2026-07-27, earlier entry 27017:2015
Cross-check only (secondary): a vendor blog that lists the same four identifiers
iso.org catalogue pages answered HTTP 403 to automated requests and were not worked around; 'published, edition 2, 2026-07' and 'first edition withdrawn' are known from search-engine result text only

unverified: which of the four controls carry guidance for the cloud service customer, for the provider, or for both (the preview contents do not say); the module asks for a result per role for every control in scope
the correspondence of the 2015 CLD.x.y.z controls to the 2026 numbering (Annex A of the 2026 edition, pages 33 to 37, is not in the preview)
which ISO/IEC 27002:2022 controls carry added cloud guidance in the 2026 edition (outside this delta module)
that iso.org lists the 2015 edition as withdrawn (search-result text only)
controls: Roles agreed with the cloud service partner
Misuse of cloud services detected and prevented

iso_27018.newer_edition: ISO/IEC 27018:2025, third edition, 2025-08 (cancels and replaces the 2019 edition; aligned with ISO/IEC 27002:2022; Annex A informative; Annex B maps to the 2019 edition). Its Annex A control identifiers are NOT verified here and may be renumbered.
iso_27018.replaces: ISO/IEC 27018:2014 (first edition; the 2019 edition is a minor revision that corrects an editorial mistake in Annex A)
iso_27018.base: ISO/IEC 27002 (2013 clause structure in the 2019 edition); Annex A adds PII-processor controls grouped by privacy principle (ISO/IEC 29100)

sources.what: Table of contents of ISO/IEC 27018:2019 as published by DIN (national standards body): Annex A (normative) sub-clauses A.1 to A.12 with the 25 control identifiers A.2.1 to A.12.2
Publisher's public preview PDF of the 2019 edition (VDE Verlag): cover (Second edition, 2019-01), contents (Annex A normative, page 15), foreword (cancels and replaces 27018:2014; minor revision)

Newer edition: publisher's public preview PDF of ISO/IEC 27018:2025 (VDE Verlag): third edition 2025-08; contents list Annex A (informative, page 22) and Annex B (correspondence with the 2019 edition, page 30) without sub-clause identifiers; foreword: cancels and replaces the 2019 edition, aligned with ISO/IEC 27002:2022
Newer edition: DIN table of contents of ISO/IEC 27018:2025-08 (Annex A listed without sub-clauses)
Cross-check only (a vendor's own statement of applicability, 2019 numbering): lists the same 25 identifiers
IEC webstore catalogue page of the 2025 edition (publication 2025-08-26), from search results; iso.org pages answered HTTP 403 to automated requests and were not worked around

unverified: the Annex A control identifiers of the 2025 third edition (its contents stop at the Annex A heading); this module is the 2019 second edition
whether the 2025 edition keeps, renumbers, merges or drops any of the 25 controls (its Annex B holds the correspondence)
the control text (not available in the previews): each of the 25 is one attestation of the declared owner's reading of the standard
controls: Processing only for the customer's purpose
Processor's own commercial use of PII
Return, transfer and disposal of PII
